title: VipPerkUpdateRequest
description: vip.perk-update-request@1: the body of vip.perk.update on OpenVibe.VIP. PATCH /api/v1/perks/:id: { name?, description?, kind?, status?, bindings? } renames, describes or retires a perk, or replaces its product bindings. Published plan versions keep the perk snapshot they were written with. Refusals are problem+json: 404 vip.perk_not_found; 422 vip.invalid_input or vip.text_too_long; 403 capability.denied. Unknown fields are ignored.

bindings.description: Replaces the perk's active bindings (a binding left out is removed). Each (product, binding) at most once.

product.description: A service id: live, chat, community, blog, …
